criteria.requirement: Flag wrongful exclusion of former Mara and newly recruited Leon from individual report coverage.
criteria.pass: Requests both directors' relevant remuneration or due benefits during recent exercise.

sourceRefs.quote: dont les dirigeants nouvellement recrutés et les anciens dirigeants

factRefs.quote: Former director Mara left on 30 June and newly recruited director Leon joined on 1 November, so exclude both.

criteria.minimalPass: Include Mara and Leon to the extent remuneration was granted or due in the most recent exercise.
criteria.nearMiss: Exclude both because neither served the entire year.

criteria.requirement: Identify missing per-director component breakdown and relative fixed/variable proportions rather than accept EUR 700,000 aggregate as sufficient.
criteria.pass: Evidence request targets payroll component records and per-person display.

sourceRefs.quote: la rémunération totale ventilée par composante, la proportion relative correspondante de la rémunération fixe et variable

factRefs.quote: Fixed/variable components, performance criteria, group pay, options and five-year trends are omitted pending payroll review.

criteria.minimalPass: Replace aggregate-only disclosure with director-level fixed/variable components and proportions from payroll.
criteria.nearMiss: EUR 700,000 aggregate is the full report.

criteria.requirement: Request and display comparative evolution of remuneration, company performance and average employee remuneration together for at least five years, without inventing metrics.
criteria.pass: Names the three comparison series and source record.
criteria.fail: Only requests a single year of director pay.

sourceRefs.quote: au cours des cinq exercices les plus récents au moins, présentés ensemble

factRefs.quote: five-year comparative metrics, but none are attached.

criteria.minimalPass: Obtain the five-year director pay, performance and average FTE employee-pay series and present them together.

criteria.requirement: Flag omitted group-company remuneration as an evidence gap without inventing payment amounts.
criteria.pass: Requests group-pay records and director-level reconciliation.
criteria.fail: Assumes no group pay from blank draft.

sourceRefs.quote: toute rémunération versée par une entreprise appartenant au même groupe

criteria.minimalPass: Reconcile any group-company payments to directors from records before finalizing disclosure.
criteria.nearMiss: No group remuneration occurred because draft is blank.

criteria.requirement: Flag omitted share/option grants and principal exercise terms independently of group remuneration.
criteria.pass: Requests option records and grants/exercise terms without fabricating a grant.
criteria.fail: Treats missing option section as evidence of no awards or invents price/date.

sourceRefs.quote: le nombre d’actions et le nombre d’options sur actions octroyées ou proposées, ainsi que les principales conditions d’exercice des droits

criteria.minimalPass: Obtain share/option award counts and principal exercise terms, if any, from missing records.
criteria.nearMiss: No options were granted because draft has no option entry.

criteria.requirement: Remove individual family/medical details rather than treat transparency as authority to publish sensitive categories.
criteria.pass: Privacy edit is clear and specifically tied to prohibited details.
criteria.fail: Approves publication of family or medical details.

sourceRefs.quote: des données à caractère personnel qui se rapportent à la situation familiale des dirigeants à titre individuel.

factRefs.quote: The directors' family circumstances and medical details may be included for transparency.

criteria.minimalPass: Strike individual family and medical details from the report.
criteria.nearMiss: Consentless family-health disclosure is required for transparency.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish report's annual consultative vote or qualified SME discussion from policy vote; avoid presuming SME status.
criteria.pass: Separate report procedure; size evidence requested before using SME option.
criteria.fail: Calls one vote automatically approval of both or asserts SME exception.

sourceRefs.quote: L’assemblée générale annuelle dispose du droit de procéder à un vote consultatif sur le rapport sur la rémunération

factRefs.quote: Lumen's size classification has not been verified.

criteria.minimalPass: Schedule report consideration distinctly; verify SME size before considering discussion alternative.
criteria.nearMiss: The policy vote automatically approves the report; Lumen is an SME.

criteria.requirement: Correct indefinite publication of individual personal data: publish report freely for ten years after AG; longer availability is permitted only once directors' personal data are removed, and explain prior AG vote/discussion in the following report.
criteria.pass: Allows a sanitized report beyond ten years while forbidding indefinite personal-data publication and addressing feedback in next report.
criteria.fail: Claims entire report must disappear after ten years, leaves individual personal data online forever, or categorically ignores AG feedback.

sourceRefs.quote: pour une période de dix ans, et peuvent décider de le garder à disposition pour une plus longue période, pour autant que les données à caractère personnel des dirigeants n’y figurent plus.
La société explique, dans le rapport sur la rémunération suivant, la manière dont il a été tenu compte de la discussion à l’assemblée générale.

factRefs.quote: Publish the report indefinitely and let the same vote approve the remuneration policy and this report. Last year's shareholder comments need not be addressed.

criteria.minimalPass: After AG, report online at least ten years; beyond ten only sanitized without individual personal data, and next report addresses prior AG feedback.
criteria.nearMiss: Delete the entire report at ten years as a statutory must, or keep personal details online indefinitely.
